wordpressScenario: Charset, YAML, legacy DOC/CFB, doctemplate, ODT, DOCX, CSL/BibTeX, table geometry, math/TeX, PDF engine, archive compression, Markdown, HTML, and XML/HTML5 DOM handoff paths remain native PHP and external-tool free. XML/HTML5 DOM handoff rejects unsafe XML DTD/entity inputs, recovers bounded HTML fragments, serializes HTML5 void and boolean attributes deterministically, and hands recovered source fragments to WordPress HTML blocks without invoking Pandoc, browser renderers, online sanitizers, or external conversion services. CSL bibliography output now preserves source-access dates and author/editor name particles/suffixes for reviewer audit lists without invoking citeproc or bibliography managers. BibTeX/BibLaTeX handoff now lets WordPress import review packets resolve common `.bib` entries into the same CSL citation and bibliography output while preserving missing keys for follow-up without invoking Pandoc, BibTeX, or Biber. PDF review packets now surface expected TeX sidecars, fake-produced artifact hashes, warning/error log summaries, and rerun-needed signals so WordPress import queues can triage renderer handoffs without running TeX/PDF engines. Table geometry now preserves body-level rowHeadColumns as WordPress th cells by visual column, scopes rowspans to table sections, and reports declared-column overflow diagnostics when imported reviewer tables need more visual columns than their Pandoc colspec metadata declares; WordPress output keeps those overflow cells instead of dropping them. ZIP package preflight now surfaces central and local NTFS media timestamps, rejects conflicting NTFS metadata, rejects Unix symlink archive entries, and reads gzip/tar plus LZ4-framed tar review packets with safe paths, skippable metadata, and checksum validation before WordPress treats embedded Office or review-packet bytes as importable attachments. The DOCX OPC preflight walks reachable relationships from the package root through nested part relationship sets, and DocxReader returns an import report for document relationships, embedded media bytes, AST-used media metadata, missing targets, cycle-safe dependency closure, bounded OMML formula handoff, tracked-change audit data, comment-range reviewer metadata, bookmark anchors, field-code hyperlinks, and section page-geometry/margin/column/header-footer relationship metadata that keep Word-created source links and layout review cues addressable in WordPress blocks. Math/TeX handoff now wraps bounded presentation MathML in semantics and includes escaped application/x-tex source annotations so imported formulas remain reviewable and accessibility tooling can recover the original TeX source without external renderers. EPUB3 package handoff preserves source-book metadata, reading order, nav/NCX review links, asset diagnostics, and XHTML spine bytes for WordPress HTML-block review without external conversion services.
